title: Grateful Dead Live at The Silver Dollar Fair on 1968-11-01
lineage: DAT (Panasonic SV-3800) > Avid MBox Pro > Pro Tools 12 > WAV (16-bit/44.1k)  Additional Mastering: WAV > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC
source: SBD > (8-track) Master Reel (10in 15ips) > DAT (Panasonic SV-3700) > DAT (Panasonic SV-3700)

ai_review.summary: Rare 8‑track soundboard delivers a stellar Cryptical Envelopment > The Other One with great clarity, though some sections suffer from signal dropouts.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the performance, especially the high‑energy Cryptical Envelopment into The Other One and its inspired coda, noting that this multi‑track source sounds clearer than earlier soundboards. However, reviewers also point out a problematic segment where the Alligator jam into Caution drops in signal quality, making the recording uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is highly praised for performance while recording is generally good but has notable dropouts; combined weighting yields a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rare 8‑track multi‑track source, generally clear and very listenable, but contains signal loss around the Alligator jam into Caution and occasional dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance builds to a powerful coda after Cryptical > The Other One, delivering strong energy; overall flow praised despite missing jam segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar is described as energetic, playfully snarling and piercing, especially during the return after the coda.
